text: CONSIDER the flight of time!<sup foot_note=103001>1</sup>

foot_notes.103001: The term "asr denotes "time" that is measurable, consisting of a succession of periods (in distinction from dahr, which signifies "unlimited time", without beginning or end: i.e., "time absolute"). Hence, asr bears the connotation of the passing or the flight of time—time which can never be recaptured.

text: Verily, man is bound to lose himself
unless he be of those<sup foot_note=103002>2</sup> who attain to faith, and do good works, and enjoin upon one another the keeping to truth, and enjoin upon one another patience in adversity.

foot_notes.103002: Lit., "man is indeed in [a state of] loss, except those...", etc
